name: Databricks SQL
description: A Databricks panel for RustGIS: browse Unity Catalog for GEOMETRY / GEOGRAPHY tables, load them with your own parameters or as dynamic layers that re-query the view as you pan and zoom, run SQL, and ask Genie in plain English (when your account has Genie). Signs in with a Databricks CLI profile.
author: Jhonatan Garrido-Lecca

commands.label: Connect
commands.help: Sign in with a Databricks CLI profile and a SQL warehouse.
commands.params: {"profile": "CLI profile", "warehouse_id": "SQL warehouse id"} (or the panel's form)

commands.label:
Browse
Spatial Tables
commands.help: List tables with GEOMETRY / GEOGRAPHY columns in a catalog.

commands.label:
Add
Table
commands.help: Add the selected table: once with your parameters, or as a dynamic layer that follows the map.

commands.label:
Add Table
in a Box
commands.help: Add the selected table, only the rows inside a box drawn on the map.
commands.params: {"table": "catalog.schema.table", "bbox": [west, south, east, north]} (or the panel's pick)

commands.label:
Refresh
Dynamic
commands.help: Re-query every dynamic layer for the current view now.

commands.label:
Stop
Dynamic
commands.help: Stop refreshing dynamic layers (they stay on the map as they are).

commands.label:
SQL
Layer
commands.help: Run a SELECT on the warehouse and add the result as a layer.

commands.label:
Ask
Genie
commands.help: Ask Genie about the selected table in plain English; the result is mapped. Needs Genie (AI/BI) in your Databricks workspace. Greyed out when your account doesn't have it.

commands.label:
Genie
Follow-up
commands.help: Ask the follow-up chosen in the panel. Needs Genie (AI/BI) in your Databricks workspace. Greyed out when your account doesn't have it.

commands.label:
New Genie
Conversation
commands.help: Start a fresh Genie conversation. Needs Genie (AI/BI) in your Databricks workspace. Greyed out when your account doesn't have it.

commands.label:
Select
Table
commands.help: Show details of the table chosen in the panel.

commands.label:
Panel
Section
commands.help: Switch the panel between Tables, SQL and Genie.

commands.label:
Load
Mode
commands.help: Switch between your own parameters and a dynamic layer.
